Description: Verify all icons in the header and footer link to the correct pages.
Expected Outcome: All links navigate successfully without 404 errors.

Description: Check that page titles and meta descriptions appear correctly in browser tabs.
Expected Outcome: Page titles and descriptions reflect accurate SEO metadata.

Description: Ensure 'Free vs Pro' comparison is clear and links to the correct upgrade paths.
Expected Outcome: Plan links correctly redirect to the corresponding upgrade checkout.

Description: Fill in all fields (Bill To, Items, Notes, Bank Details).
Expected Outcome: All fields can be edited smoothly without lag.

Description: Verify VAT (7.5%), Discounts, and Subtotals update instantly as you type.
Expected Outcome: Calculations reflect correct totals immediately.

Description: Switch between ₦ (Naira), $, and others. Ensure symbols are correct.
Expected Outcome: Currency symbols update across all monetary fields.

Description: Generate a PDF. Check logo alignment, font clarity, branding, and watermark.
Expected Outcome: PDF is generated perfectly styled, matching the web preview.

Description: Click 'Share via WhatsApp' and ensure it opens the correct pre-filled message.
Expected Outcome: WhatsApp opens with a formatted message and correct invoice link.

Description: Provide a simple prompt (e.g., 'Web design for 200k').
Expected Outcome: AI generates correct dummy items matching the prompt context.

Description: Edit the AI-suggested fields.
Expected Outcome: The edited fields save correctly and update the totals.

Description: Test with a fresh email. Verify email confirmation link.
Expected Outcome: User receives validation email and successfully verifies account.

Description: Test one-click login with a Google account.
Expected Outcome: Login completes immediately without requiring email verification.

Description: Test the 'Forgot Password' flow from start to finish.
Expected Outcome: User receives recovery email and password is successfully reset.

Description: After first login, ensure user is prompted to set up Business Profile.
Expected Outcome: User sees the onboarding wizard/modal for business specifics.

Description: Verify tooltips or a 'First Steps' guide works.
Expected Outcome: Tooltips correctly highlight interface areas.

Description: Confirm that 'Total Revenue,' 'Overdue,' and 'Paid' stats update on changes.
Expected Outcome: Dashboard stats reflect the correct aggregate invoice values.

Description: Ensure new invoices appear at the top of the list immediately.
Expected Outcome: List accurately sorts by the newest creation/update date.

Description: Create, View, Edit, and Delete invoices.
Expected Outcome: All basic operations are executed without database errors.

Description: Mark an invoice as 'Sent,' then 'Paid,' then 'Cancelled.'
Expected Outcome: Dashboard correctly updates the status badge for the invoice.

Description: Use 'Duplicate' feature. Does it copy all items but reset the invoice number?
Expected Outcome: New invoice is populated with previous data but has a new unique ID.

Description: Add a client. View their specific 'Invoicing History.'
Expected Outcome: Clients save correctly and their history page shows relevant invoices.

Description: If applicable, switch businesses and ensure data does not leak.
Expected Outcome: Only invoices relevant to the selected business are displayed.

Description: Create a monthly recurring invoice. Verify the UI shows the 'Next Run Date.'
Expected Outcome: Schedule is properly saved and next date is correctly calculated.

Description: Create a credit note for a specific invoice.
Expected Outcome: Credit note reduces the balance of the original invoice accurately.

Description: Send an invoice via the platform's email system. Check inbox and 'View' link.
Expected Outcome: Email lands in inbox formatted correctly; view link opens the invoice.

Description: Generate a unique payment link. Does it show a clean payment page?
Expected Outcome: Payment page renders well with correct amount and business details.

Description: Select a 'Pro' plan.
Expected Outcome: Plan details and pricing display correctly on checkout screen.

Description: Complete a subscription payment using Test Cards.
Expected Outcome: Payment is successful and account is upgraded instantly.

Description: Ensure user can manage their subscription from settings.
Expected Outcome: User can cancel their plan cleanly without throwing errors.

Description: Check for smooth animations and hover effects. No layout shifts.
Expected Outcome: UI feels premium and responsive without jarring page jumps.

Description: Verify buttons are large enough. Forms are easy to type in on small screens.
Expected Outcome: Forms resize correctly, keyboard doesn't hide input fields.

Description: Ensure the mobile menu opens and closes smoothly.
Expected Outcome: Nav menu functions flawlessly on mobile.

Description: Watch 10-20 sessions. Identify Rage Clicks, Dead Clicks, Funnel Drops.
Expected Outcome: Friction points are identified and logged.

Description: Analyze if users see the 'Try Premium' CTA or reach bottom of landing page.
Expected Outcome: Scroll depth and click accuracy are logged for feedback.
